sql_templates.template:
SELECT ce.symbol, ce.event_type, ce.event_date, ra.verdict, ss.stage
FROM signals.corporate_events ce
JOIN scores.results_analysis ra ON ce.symbol = ra.symbol
JOIN scores.stage_snapshots ss ON ce.symbol = ss.symbol
WHERE ss.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots)
AND ra.verdict IN ('beat', 'miss')
AND ce.event_type IN ('RESULTS', 'DIVIDEND', 'SPLIT', 'BONUS', 'AGM')
ORDER BY ce.event_date DESC
LIMIT 10;
